scope: Instances of the Becoming core's countdown, stock and gate laws in the versioned task protocol. The head of the queue is counted work (Countdown.Advances): each tick does one hop of its remaining path and with none left delivers the request, so under the bank and queue invariant the head completes after its remaining length plus one tick with the rest of the queue, the banks and the active route unchanged (valid_head_completes is an instance), and every shorter drain leaves it pending with nothing delivered. Rewriting the head keeps its route, progress and the rest of the queue, so the revised head completes in the same number of ticks with the new request (revised_head_completes is an instance). Review draws one unit of work and action two, so an endpoint completes its review and action exactly when the report clears the relevant risk and the work covers the course [1, 2] (Stock.Covered), that is from three units. For every condition and every valid installation with a pending head, acquisition, revision, reform, the rewrite of the head and its delivery run exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance and end in the learning practice with one loss, three records and the work (2, 6, 10) (acquired_revision_changes_pending_action is the instance at harmful). For every condition, report and pending endpoint, a review adds a loss exactly when the report clears the action, the work covers the course and the practice's relevant risk, its outcome law's loss condition, holds; every review whose report does not clear the action keeps the loss count (Gated.KeptBy), and so does every course of such reviews. Correspondence of the protocol to actual requests, authority or reviews is not checked.
